title: One Holy Church
firstLine: 2-3 stanzas and chorus by T. S. T.

lines: 2-3 stanzas and chorus by T. S. T.
One holy church of God appears,
Unwasted by the lapse of years,
One book to guide the pilgrim's feet,
How God would have us live.
One name by which each one is known
One way that leads the saints of God
To joys and bliss in Heav'n.
"There shall be one fold; one shepherd." (John 10:17)
There shall be One fold, One shepherd, One plan of saving grace!
